templates.name: image_p_h3_image_edit
templates.title: P-H3-Image: Image Edit
templates.description: Pruna AI's few-step image model built on MiniMax-H3: edit the source image with a short instruction, up to 9 reference images, 8-step sampling.

templates.name: image_p_h3_t2i
templates.title: P-H3-Image: Text to Image
templates.description: Pruna AI's few-step image model built on MiniMax-H3: write a plain-language request and a local prompt upsampler expands it into a detailed scene before an 8-step sample. Pick the aspect ratio and megapixel target on the Resolution Selector to move between square, 4:3, 16:9 and portrait canvases.

templates.name: image_qwen_image_2_1_turbo_t2i
templates.title: Qwen Image 2.1 Turbo: Text to Image
templates.description: Generate images from text prompts with Qwen Image 2.1 Turbo, the 8-step accelerated checkpoint, producing a single 1024×1024 image in 8 sampling steps. Same model family with native 2K output, professional typography, and alpha-channel support, plus an optional Qwen 3.5 prompt enhancer. Ideal for poster and layout design, transparent asset creation, and rapid concept visualization.

templates.name: api_openai_gpt_image_26_flare_t2i
templates.title: GPT Image 2.6 Flare: Text to Image
templates.description: GPT Image 2.6 Flare is OpenAI's speed-first image model: it returns a draft in seconds and holds the layout together on dense posters and product shots. Use it for concept passes, mood boards and typography-heavy drafts, then switch to a higher quality setting for the final image.

templates.name: api_google_gemini_omni_flash_1_2_t2v
templates.title: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash: Text to Video
templates.description: Write the shot and get a 5-second 16:9 clip with synchronized audio: ambience, footsteps and UI clicks come out of the same pass. Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash keeps a fixed cast and layout across the clip, so game-lobby key art, product beats and menu shots hold together.

templates.name: 3d_idol_image_to_gaussian_splat
templates.title: Idol: Image to Gaussian Splat
templates.description: Turn a single image into a 3D Gaussian splat with Idol, Comfy-Org's fine-tune of TripoSplat: BiRefNet removes the backdrop, DINOv3 and the Flux2 VAE encode the view, and one pass decodes a 262k-point splat. Exports a .spz splat, an orbit preview and an experimental .glb mesh. Best on stylized characters and props.
